🚀 maple-videos | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Self-hosting and serving personal video content without reliance on third-party platforms.
✨ Key Features: • Video uploads with size limits and format checks • Real video validation using ffprobe • Background transcoding to HLS with FFmpeg • Built-in player powered by hls.js • Video list on homepage
📖 Summary: Maple-videos is an open-source, self-hosted video hosting platform that allows users to upload, transcode, and serve their own videos using a built-in player. It aims to provide an alternative to corporate video platforms by keeping user data on their own servers.
